function_v0.doc: Converts up to `max_events` pre-1.7.0 event records, returning how many\nremain. Loop until it reports zero, then call `migrate`. Paged because\none invocation cannot touch every event of a deployment with history.
function_v0.name: migrate_events

fields.doc: Award amount in token-native units. Allocation happens here, at payout,\nnot at create: the event holds a pool and each selection names what it\nspends from it.
fields.name: amount

fields.doc:
Advertised minimum per position, in token-native units. `select_winners`
may pay above a floor but never below it, so a published prize table is
a guarantee rather than an estimate. Positions absent from the map carry
no floor and are payable at any positive amount.
fields.name: prize_floors

event_v0.doc: The fee withheld from a crowdfunding release. `MilestoneClaimed.amount`\nstays gross; the creator received `amount - fee`.
event_v0.name: MilestoneFeeCharged
